subject: prd/installer
statement: Where artifacts are resolved, the system shall fetch every artifact from the effective artifact source — the distribution door by default, or a configured override — under the same manifest-hash verification, and `preview` and `doctor` shall report that effective source and whether it is the default or an override.
rationale: a mirror can serve bytes but never choose them, so the channel may move freely; what may not move is the operator's ability to see which channel is answering
fit_criterion: default-source and override-configured fixtures both fetch from the effective source and both refuse checksum mismatches; preview and doctor name the effective source and label it default or override
